### call 1: node=spark-2 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
unit=dgx-cluster-dep-cluster-profile.service
systemctl --user stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user reset-failed "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
### call 2: node=spark-2 timeout=35 check=False
set -eu
script_path=/recipes/stop.sh
expected_hash=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
test -r "$script_path"
bash -n "$script_path"
test "$(sha256sum "$script_path" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash"
env_file=/recipes/.env.dgx-controller-cluster-profile
test -r "$env_file" || env_file=/recipes/.env
test -r "$env_file"
cd /recipes
ENV_FILE="$env_file" /bin/bash "$script_path"
### call 3: node=spark-2 timeout=15 check=False
set -u
root=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" || unlink "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
legacy_root=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" \
  || unlink "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
### end
